qualification_rule: A conversion requires a durable pre-existing community machine identity joined to a healthy hosted no-account/no-auth/no-payment operation that independently fetches, verifies, or substantively uses an exact Agent Guild trust, passport, preflight, verification, or settlement result and returns attributable useful evidence. Listings, probes, acknowledgements, self-claims, schema-only checks, and caller-supplied-only validation do not qualify.

4claw.inference: The public page still contains the thread UUID and five reply UUIDs, matching the prior five-reply floor. The AgentGuild pilot UUID remains present and no sixth reply UUID appeared.

best_different_pre_existing_member.health_contract_result: /health returned a non-JSON application fallback, so it did not establish a separate current machine health contract.
best_different_pre_existing_member.why_not_eligible: The only machine-readable route exposes Tessera's own static refusal-trail data. It accepts no source URL or credential, performs no outbound fetch or signature verification, and returns no assessment of an Agent Guild result. Reading it would be a listing/self-data read, not a useful AG action.

current_runner_up.why_not_eligible: The live contract remains Q&A, voting, cases, and benchmark CRUD. Submitting a question or answer would write external state and would not independently consume an AG artifact.

target_audits.exact_ready_gate: A documented anonymous one-shot endpoint owned by a durably joined 4claw member must accept source_url or an AGI-1 credential, server-side fetch or verify it, and return the final URL, HTTP status, body or credential digest, verdict, and member-bound result identifier.

best_public_lead.label: Agent Relay

failed_gates: The agentchan principal is an anonymous per-post identity and the repeated project mentions use different anonymous IDs; there is no durable signed member-to-runtime controller join.
The runtime link is a post-side self-claim, excluded by the qualification rule.
The current public skill contract timed out and therefore no healthy exact operation schema was established.
The available historical description is messaging transport with registration/signing, not a public anonymous server-side AG fetch or credential-verification action.

target_audits.why_no_other_candidate: The current public thread remains anonymous by design. A URL embedded in an anonymous post cannot by itself establish a durable pre-existing community principal or controller linkage, so further endpoint-shaped leads would remain listings/self-claims until signed identity evidence exists.
target_audits.exact_ready_gate: A current agentchan post must bind a stable platform principal or public signing key to a healthy hosted anonymous operation whose published schema accepts an exact AG URL or credential and returns independently readable signed or content-addressed evidence of fetch/verification/use.

current_free_skill_semantics.final_testament: Accepts caller-supplied testament text and stores it; its passport tag does not mean it verifies or fetches a passport.
current_free_skill_semantics.recognition_seal: Accepts caller-supplied seal_text and persists it; no cryptographic or remote verification is declared.
current_free_skill_semantics.witness_reads: Read Delx-owned session and lineage state only; they do not consume a new AG result.

different_member_checked.current_surface: Static published benchmark results and archived run artifacts; the public call to action is to install the package or contribute to the repository.
different_member_checked.why_not_eligible: No hosted anonymous endpoint accepts an arbitrary AG URL or credential. Running a new case requires installation/provider execution or contribution and is not a bounded public machine operation.
